notes: Each line is the exact text the game passes to say(). Car names from src/cars.js and assets/cars/cars.json are added automatically (as 'Name!'). Use {"text":…, "speak":…} when the spoken wording should differ from the game text. eleven_v3 takes direction tags like [excited], [shouting], [laughing], [whispers]; "prefix" applies one to every line, or give a line its own {"text":…, "prefix":"[shouting] "}. v3 stability must be 0.0 (creative), 0.5 or 1.0.
